FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
The card stays state property subject to denial, cancelation, suspension, or revocation, while driving itself is the earned privilege the card permits [A01].
Why it matters: group privilege-vs-property; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A01
Four- or eight-year terms run from the fee month to its last day, while renewal opens a full year before expiry [A01].
Why it matters: group terms; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A01
Non-citizens face an examiner showing every immigration paper each visit with matching expirations, while permanent residents renew or replace anywhere on a valid resident card [A01].
Why it matters: group non-citizens; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A01
Posted military members gain sixty days past return with optional mail renewal, while civilians expired over a year must appear in person with birth or passport proof [A01].
Why it matters: group renewal-paths; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F03; confusables sec02-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A01
Ten-day move notice runs through operators, online, or the listed post box, while name changes need certified marriage or court papers, and stale records risk suspension without notice [A01].
Why it matters: group notice-duties; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A01
Probation covers every license until eighteen, when any unlawful act, negligence, or misconduct can cancel or suspend it [A01].
Why it matters: group probation; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A01
Unlicensed driving incriminates both the driver and whoever allowed it even with a licensed companion present, matching the bans on parental permission and lending to the unlicensed [A01].
Why it matters: group unauthorized-driving; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A02
Unlicensed driving and restriction violations share one penalty ladder of five hundred dollars, six months, or both on conviction [A02].
Why it matters: group penalties; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A02
Letter codes B and F adapt vision and hearing while numbered codes two through eight adapt transmission, steering, diet, limbs, and special conditions [A02].
Why it matters: group medical-codes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A02
Code nine pairs learners with a twenty-one-plus front companion, while code zero cages under-sixteen riders by engine size, hours, passengers, and speed until sixteen with helmets to eighteen [A02].
Why it matters: group learner-codes; difficulty high; prereq sec02-F10; confusables sec02-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A02
Obsolete restrictions clear through an examiner alone, while added endorsements demand an examiner plus passed tests [A02].
Why it matters: group changes; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F12 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0014]
